## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Verification

List checks run and their results, including checks you could not run.

## Review notes

Call out database migrations, configuration changes, compatibility limits, and rollout considerations if applicable. For visible changes, include Arabic/English screenshots with synthetic data.

- [ ] Changes contain no credentials or real user data.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and regression coverage are updated.
- [ ] Third-party material is identified and its notices preserved.
